note: Public, redacted repository captures from 9 November 2026. Dark blocks hide identifying values. These illustrate UI and data-model design, not fresh functional, security or acceptance tests. Dashboard values are historical cached snapshots, not live KPIs.

sections.title: Inventory and dealership locations
sections.description: Custom Vehicle and Rooftop objects connect stock, pricing, location and service capacity. The captures highlight field design, lookup modeling and administrative list-view configuration.

sections.title: Financing and approvals
sections.description: A custom Financing object, LWC quick action and Apex-backed estimates connect finance requirements with native approval administration. Demo rates are illustrative; the submission dialog does not prove routing or approval completion.

images.caption: Approval submission: native comments dialog, not proof of a completed approval.

sections.title: Service operations
sections.description: Custom Service Visit and standard Service Appointment forms demonstrate object selection, required fields and related-record design for workshop intake and scheduling. They do not establish a licensed Field Service implementation or a completed booking.

images.alt: Custom Service Visit form with vehicle, contact, staff, labour, parts and work fields; owner masked.
images.caption: Service Visit: custom workshop intake, assignments and cost fields.

images.alt: Standard Service Appointment form with parent record, scheduling window, address and status fields.
images.caption: Service Appointment: standard scheduling fields and parent-record relationships.

sections.title: Loyalty data model
sections.description: Custom member and transaction objects model rewards tiers, balances and points history through relational and audit-oriented field design. This is not Salesforce Loyalty Management, and the captures do not verify accrual or ledger correctness.

images.caption: Member enrollment: custom membership lifecycle and tier fields.

images.alt: Custom Loyalty Transaction record with points, type, reason, expiry and related records; audit names masked.
images.caption: Loyalty Transaction: points-history relationships and audit-oriented fields.
